questions.question: Dr. Barakat treats a civil servant patient affiliated with the CNOPS. According to Law 54.23 adopted in January 2026, what major change will occur in the management of the AMO for this patient?
options: The CNOPS remains the sole manager of the AMO for the public sector
The management of the public sector AMO will be transferred to the CNSS
Patients will have to take out individual private insurance
The AMO scheme for civil servants will be abolished
questions.explanation: Law 54.23, adopted in January 2026, provides for entrusting the management of the basic AMO scheme for the public sector to a single body, the CNSS.

questions.question: Dr. Harakat has a civil servant patient who is wondering about the future of their AMO reimbursements. According to Law 54.23, what happens to agreements signed with mutual insurance companies?
options: They remain in force for a duration set by decree
They are automatically taken over by the CNSS
They become void on the date of promulgation of the law
questions.explanation: Agreements concluded with mutual insurance companies remain in force for a duration to be set by decree, to ensure a gradual transition.

questions.question: According to Law 54.23, what is the new age limit for AMO coverage for an unmarried student pursuing their studies?
questions.explanation: Law 54.23 extends the coverage age for unmarried students pursuing their studies up to age 30, instead of 26.

questions.question: Dr. Barakat treats a 28-year-old student patient. According to the developments of Law 54.23, how can this patient benefit from the AMO?
options: Through the specific AMO-students scheme which is maintained
As a dependent of a primary insured person
They can no longer benefit from any AMO coverage
Through a special scheme for foreign students only
questions.explanation: Law 54.23 abolishes the specific insurance scheme for students. The majority of them can now benefit from coverage as dependents.

questions.question: Dr. Harakat has a patient who wants to have a ceramic-ceramic crown placed. According to mutual insurance companies, what is the recent additional flat-rate amount introduced by the MGPAP?
questions.explanation: The MGPAP has introduced a specific additional reimbursement for ceramic-ceramic crowns at a flat rate of 360 DH per tooth.

questions.question: According to the MGPAP, what is the total reimbursement rate (AMO + complementary insurance) for a ceramic-ceramic crown?
questions.explanation: The total reimbursement amount (AMO + Complementary Insurance) for a ceramic-ceramic crown is 2,360 DH per tooth.

questions.question: Dr. Barakat has a patient who wants to get a dental implant. According to the general rules of the AMO and mutual insurance companies, what is the situation?
options: The AMO reimburses the implant at 80%
The implant is not covered by the AMO, but may be covered by some mutual insurance companies
All mutual insurance companies reimburse implants without conditions
The State covers the full cost of implants
questions.explanation: The AMO does not cover dental implants, but some complementary mutual insurance companies may offer coverage. The level of coverage depends on the contract subscribed.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, which body manages the AMO for a patient in the private sector?
questions.explanation: The AMO is managed by the CNSS for the private sector and by the CNOPS for the public sector.

questions.question: Dr. Harakat treats a non-salaried worker (TNS). According to Law 65-00, what is the specific scheme for this category?
options: They are not entitled to the AMO
They fall under the AMO-TNS scheme
They must take out private insurance
questions.explanation: The AMO-TNS scheme is provided for self-employed workers, liberal professions, and other non-salaried activities.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, are cosmetic surgery procedures covered by the AMO?
options: No, they are excluded from the scope of benefits
Yes, provided they have a mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: Cosmetic surgery procedures are excluded from the scope of benefits guaranteed by the AMO, including aesthetic veneers and teeth whitening.

questions.question: Dr. Barakat must perform a dental prosthesis on a patient. According to mutual insurance company rules, what administrative procedure is often necessary?
options: A prior agreement with submission of a detailed quote
A simple invoice to send after treatment
A verbal agreement with the patient
questions.explanation: Dental prostheses or orthodontics often require a prior agreement, with submission of a detailed quote before starting treatment.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, are workplace accidents covered by the AMO?
options: No, they are governed by specific legislation
Yes, but only for civil servants
questions.explanation: Risks related to workplace accidents and occupational diseases remain governed by specific legislation, outside the scope of the AMO.

questions.question: Dr. Harakat has a patient who changed employers (from public to private). According to AMO rules, how does the change of manager occur?
options: The patient must manually register with the CNSS
The transfer is automatic with coordination between bodies
The patient loses their coverage for 6 months
The patient must take out private insurance
questions.explanation: Rules of coordination between the different managing bodies are provided in case of mobility of employees between the public and private sectors.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, what is the 'co-payment' for an AMO patient?
options: The portion remaining the patient's responsibility after AMO reimbursement
The amount reimbursed by the mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: The co-payment is the portion remaining the responsibility of the insured after AMO reimbursement, generally 20% of the National Reference Tariff.

questions.question: Dr. Barakat treats a civil servant patient. According to Law 65-00, what is the AMO contribution rate for the public sector?
options: 5% shared equally between employee and employer
questions.explanation: The contribution rate for the public sector is set at 5% of all salaries, shared equally between the employee and the employer.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, how are disabled children of an AMO insured covered?
questions.explanation: Dependent disabled children benefit from AMO coverage without age limit.

questions.question: Dr. Harakat has a patient who has no AMO coverage and cannot pay their contributions. According to Law 65-00, which scheme can they join?
options: No scheme, they must pay for their care
questions.explanation: The AMO-TADAMON scheme is provided for people unable to pay their contributions, with the State covering the total amount of contributions.

questions.question: According to recent developments of the MGPAP, what is the new flat-rate reimbursement added for medical consultations?
questions.explanation: An additional reimbursement of 10 DH has been allocated for each medical consultation (public and private), including dental care.

questions.question: According to AMO rules, what is the maximum deadline for submitting a reimbursement request for dental care?
questions.explanation: Documents must be submitted within the deadlines set by the body, often within 60 days following the date of care.

questions.question: Dr. Barakat must perform orthodontic treatment on a young patient. According to mutual insurance company rules, what is the recommended procedure?
options: Obtain a prior agreement with submission of a quote and an X-ray
Wait until the end of treatment to request reimbursement
Make do with a verbal agreement with the mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: Orthodontics requires a prior agreement with submission of a detailed quote accompanied by an X-ray or medical report.

questions.question: According to Law 54.23, what does the text provide for foreign students?
options: They are not entitled to the AMO
They benefit from the AMO through an agreement with the relevant authorities
They must take out private insurance
They are excluded from the Moroccan health system
questions.explanation: Foreign students will benefit from the AMO under an agreement between the CNSS and the relevant governmental authorities, institutions, and bodies.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, what is the basic AMO reimbursement rate for routine dental care?
questions.explanation: The AMO generally reimburses 80% of the National Reference Tariff (TNR) for consultations, caries treatment, and extractions.

questions.question: Dr. Harakat has a patient affiliated with the MGPAP. What is the particularity of this mutual insurance company?
options: It is reserved for private sector employees
It is specific to public administration personnel
It is open to all citizens without conditions
It is exclusive to liberal professions
questions.explanation: The MGPAP (General Mutual Insurance Company for Public Administration Personnel) is a non-profit social body created in 1948, specific to public administration personnel.

questions.question: According to general rules, what is the role of the complementary mutual insurance company in relation to the AMO?
options: It increases the AMO reimbursement rates
It manages the AMO for the public sector
It is reserved for cosmetic procedures
questions.explanation: Complementary mutual insurance companies increase the AMO reimbursement rates (e.g., 80% + 16 to 20% additional).

questions.question: According to available information, what is the total reimbursement rate of the MGPAP for reimbursable medications (AMO + complementary)?
questions.explanation: Members of the MGPAP benefit from a total reimbursement rate of 90% of the public price of the medication (AMO + complementary).
